notes:
Medication & feedback fixes
Medication: the Add form is much shorter. Schedule and "More options" (cycle, stock, shelf life, sites, supplies, notes) are each one tidy line you can open. A pen has a new "Pen click size" box where you can type how many clicks your dose takes, and a "Not the right number of clicks?" button on the medication page fixes it in one step.
Feedback: if the automatic send fails, the real reason is shown with buttons to email it from your own email app or copy it.
